profile.title: Profile
profile.photoDesc: Shown in the sidebar and across the app.
profile.name: Your name

profile.signOutDesc: Sign out of feega on this device.
profile.figmaDesc: Paste a personal access token so pasting from Figma brings its images too. Layers and text paste without one.
profile.figmaTokenSet: A token is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
profile.figmaTokenHint: Figma, Settings, Security, Personal access tokens. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
profile.figmaTestedScope: Figma accepted the token. It has no Current user scope, so the account name is hidden; images still work.
profile.figmaRejected: Figma did not accept this token.

profile.cloudDesc: Import files onto the canvas and export back. Connect from the file picker on the canvas.
profile.cloudNotConfigured: Not set up on this server
profile.cookieHint: Choose which analytics and marketing cookies feega may use.
profile.exportHint: A JSON file with your profile, workspaces, projects, messages you wrote and the credit history of workspaces you own.
profile.deleteHint: Deletes your login, profile, API keys and chats you started. Workspaces where you are the only member are deleted with their files, and their plan is cancelled at period end. Workspaces shared with others keep their work. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteConfirmLabel: Type DELETE or your email to confirm
profile.deleteConfirmError: Type DELETE or your email exactly.
profile.deleteReauth: For safety, sign in again (within the last 15 minutes) and retry.
profile.deleteTransfer: You are the only owner of a workspace with other members. Make someone else owner, or remove the members, first.
profile.memoryDesc: What the Feega chat knows about you: who you are, your taste, how you like to work. Paste what your AI already knows, or write it yourself.
profile.memoryPlaceholder: Copy the prompt, paste it into Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, and paste what it writes here.
profile.memorySaved: Memory saved. The chat uses it from your next message.
profile.memoryTooLong: That is too long. Keep it under 20,000 characters.
